Tooltip: Copy of file aging confins from source folder into the destination folder.

Arguments.Name: FileNameAgingConfins
Arguments.Tooltip: File name of aging confins that want to be copied from source location into destination folder location. The paramater {{Date}} is the date from argument DateAgingConfins.

Arguments.Name: DestinationFolderAgingConfins
Arguments.Tooltip: Path location destination folder of the process copy file aging confins.

Arguments.Name: SourceFolderAgingConfins
Arguments.Tooltip: Path location of source aging folder that contains aging confins file for process copy the file into destination folder path.

Arguments.Name: DateAgingConfins
Arguments.Tooltip:
The Date file aging confins that want to be copied into local folder. Date must be in format dd-MM-yyyy. 
Example: 01-01-2025

If it is empty the default value is the current date.

Arguments.Name: OverwriteFileAgingConfins
Arguments.Tooltip: Flag to overwrite the file aging confins if in destination folder is already exists. The default value is False.

Arguments.Name: ResultCopyAgingConfins
Arguments.Tooltip: Result of path location file aging confins that successfully to copied.
